battle.name: 宋夏戰爭
battle.brief: 一〇三八年六月西夏主元昊在興慶府稱帝，國號大夏，宋廷削官封停歲賜，戰端由此開。九月元昊三路出師，定川寨、鄜延相繼失守，十一月宋軍援環州又全軍覆沒於好水川。此役火攻僅止於火矢與猛火油；卡面的拜占庭希臘火同樣以火阻騎，配方卻隨沉船失落，從未東傳。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 一〇三八年開戰的兩方是北宋與西夏。北宋方面，陝西沿邊分秦鳳、鄜延、環慶、熙河四路，各路節度使與知州分守城寨，兵源以禁軍精銳、廂軍、募來的蕃兵與邊民弓箭手為主，器械以步卒長槍大刀配合蹶張弓、霹靂弓、牀子弩與各類砲箭；朝廷以樞密院調度天下兵馬，陝西經略安撫司要到康定元年才正式設置，此前各路互相支援要靠中書省一紙文書，效率極低。西夏方面，元昊合併宥州、靜州、靈州諸部，以興慶府為都，仿宋制設中書省與樞密院，漢臣張儼、野利仁榮掌尚書與出使文書，黨項部眾按戶出丁，戰時自備弓甲與口糧，行軍迅捷而糧秣極不穩；主戰兵是披鐵甲的鐵鷂子重騎，步兵在前列陣，輕騎兩翼包抄。三國格局是這場戰爭的背景：宋與遼有澶淵之盟在，夏一面臣於宋、一面與遼時戰時和，宋廷想用削封逼夏稱臣，夏則想在宋、遼之間取利，兩邊都清楚對方的算盤。
countriesEn: The two parties that went to war in 1038 were the Northern Song and Western Xia. On the Song side the frontier in Shaanxi was divided into four circuits — Qinfeng, Fuyan, Huanqing and Xihe — each guarded by its own military commissioner and prefect, with the fighting men drawn from the elite imperial guards, the provincial levies, recruited Tibetan auxiliaries and the bowmen of the border villages; the infantry carried long spears and broadswords, supported by the draw-heavy Zhuzhang bow, the powerful Pili bow, the bed-mounted repeating crossbow and a variety of catapult shot and arrows. The court moved troops across the empire through the Bureau of Military Affairs, and the Shaanxi Pacification Commission was not formally established until the first year of Kangding, so before that the circuits could only be brought to each other's aid by a single memorandum from the Central Secretariat, which was extremely slow. On the Xia side Yuanhao had merged the Youzhou, Jingzhou and Lingzhou divisions, made Xingqing Prefecture his capital, and copied Song institutions by creating a Secretariat and a Board of War; Han clerks such as Zhang Yan and Ye Li Renrong handled the memorial literature and the envoys; Tangut households each furnished a man, and the soldiers carried their own bows, armour and rations into the field, so the army marched fast but its food was never secure. The main striking force was the armoured iron-vulture heavy horse, with infantry forming up in front and light horse working the flanks. A three-power setting formed the background of the war: the Song and the Liao were bound by the Chanyuan treaty, Xia was at once a subject of the Song and a partner of the Liao in shifting wars and truces, the Song court meant to force Xia into submission by cutting its titles away, and Xia meant to profit between the two, and each side knew the other's arithmetic well enough.
people: 西夏主李元昊是全場的樞紐。他整合三個党項分部、統一軍令，用漢人官僚處理文書與外交，自稱嵬理，於一〇三八年六月在興慶府建國，隨即把矛頭指向宋境。漢臣張儼與野利仁榮替他掌中樞文牘、議和時出任使者，往返於興慶府與汴京之間，是西夏與宋廷之間唯一穩定的溝通渠道。宋方最被記住的是一〇三八年十一月的敗將：副都統折可能統步騎萬餘赴環州援定川寨，屯兵好水川河谷，中夏軍伏兵，糧道被斷、士卒疲餒，一戰而潰，主帥僅以身免；此役之後宋廷追究沿邊將帥與堡寨失修之責，撤換了整批官員。另一端是曹瑋，他在康定年間出守渭州，於一〇四一年再戰好水川，以弩手、車陣與精騎掩擊擊潰夏軍，是這場戰爭中宋軍少數的硬仗。范仲淹一〇四〇年出任陝西經略安撫副使，修城築寨、練兵屯田，同年十一月遞上答手詔條陳十事，正式請議和；宣撫使夏竦主戰，兩人在朝中互相攻訐，政爭的伏線就埋在這幾年。沈括則以幕府幕僚的身分留在延州，記下石油，也記下狄青披銅面具出陣、夏人稱其為狄天使的細節。
peopleEn: The pivot of the whole affair was the Xia ruler Li Yuanhao. He welded the three Tangut divisions into one, unified the command, employed Han clerks to handle the written business and the diplomacy, styled himself Weili, and in June 1038 founded his state at Xingqing Prefecture, turning his spear at Song territory at once. The Han officials Zhang Yan and Ye Li Renrong ran the central paperwork for him and went out as envoys during the peace talks, moving between Xingqing and Bianjing, and they were the only stable channel of communication between Xia and the Song court. The Song figure most remembered is the loser of November 1038: the deputy commander-in-chief Zhe Keneng led some ten thousand foot and horse towards Huanzhou to relieve Dingchuanzhai and encamped in the valley of Haoshuichuan, where the Xia ambushed him, cut his supply line and caught his troops worn and hungry; the army broke in a single action and the commander escaped with his life alone. After this the court called the frontier commanders and the decaying forts to account and replaced a whole batch of officials. At the other end stands Cao Wei, who governed Weizhou in the Kangding years and fought at Haoshuichuan again in 1041, breaking the Xia army with crossbowmen, waggon barricades and a cavalry counter-stroke, one of the few hard fights the Song army won in this war. Fan Zhongyan was appointed deputy commissioner for Shaanxi in 1040, repairing walls, building forts, drilling the troops and opening farms, and in the eleventh month of the same year presented the Reply to the Imperial Edict with Ten Articles, formally asking for negotiations; the commissioner Xia Song stood for war, the two men attacked each other in court, and the seeds of that political feud were sown in these very years. Shen Kuo, for his part, stayed at Yanzhou as a staff officer in the military command, and it was there that he recorded the petroleum and also the detail of Di Qing going out in a bronze mask, an apparition the Xia troops called the envoy of Di.
kits: 卡面這件希臘火是七世紀拜占庭帝國的秘密兵器：稠厚難熄的燃燒劑灌在銅管裡，由船上的操作手以人力泵推送，噴向水面或牆根；帝國把配方列為最高機密，傳說配方隨一艘沉船一同失落，此後再沒有第二套辦法。它的戰術任務只有一個——用火封住正在移動的對手，使敵船失去靠岸的動力；管口小、射程短，它從來不是野戰投射兵器，而是船首與城牆上的近距離阻斷工具。希臘火沒有出現在一〇三八年的陝西，也沒有任何線索顯示它曾東傳。真正可以對照的，是同一戰區裡的猛火油與石油：沈括在《夢溪筆談》記鄜延境內有石油，燃之如麻、煙甚濃，所沾帷幕皆黑，他試以煙製墨；宋人把以石油為膏、以管壓出的噴射器械記作猛火油柜，《武經總要》在一〇四四年把它列進器械圖說，作為守城與攻樓的燃燒手段；西夏軍中同樣備有油料，攻城與夜襲時用來燒宋軍的糧草與雲梯。除油料之外，宋軍用火之處更多是火矢與火球，火矢燒敵陣、擾糧隊，火球在攻城時用於遮蔽密集隊形。西夏則靠鐵鷂子的重騎與冷兵器：人馬皆披鐵甲，專為衝鋒而設，破陣之後不留原地，轉眼即退。宋軍缺馬，步多騎少，靠蹶張弓、霹靂弓與牀子弩壓制衝鋒，以橐車排列成活動拒馬，糧秣與箭矢由車隊隨軍轉運，屯田與關中運糧線則供應遠程堡寨。
kitsEn: The Greek fire on this card is the secret weapon of the seventh-century Byzantine Empire: a thick burning fluid, hard to extinguish, poured into bronze tubes and pushed out by hand pumps worked by the men on the ship, sprayed at the waterline or at the foot of a wall. The empire kept the formula as its highest secret, and the story runs that it was lost with a ship that sank, so that no second way of making it was ever found. Its tactical task was a single one — to use fire to seal a target that was moving, to rob an enemy ship of the motive power it needed to come alongside. The bore was small and the reach short, so it was never a field projectile but a close-range blocking tool for ship bows and city walls. Greek fire did not appear in Shaanxi in 1038, and no trace suggests that it ever travelled east. What can genuinely be set beside it is the fierce-fire oil and the petroleum of the same theatre: Shen Kuo recorded in the Dream Pool Essays that there is petroleum inside the Fuyan border, that it burns like hemp with heavy smoke that blackens any curtain it touches, and he tried to make ink from its soot; the Song called the projecting device that held petroleum paste in a tube and pressed it out the fierce-fire oil chest, and the Wujing Zongyao of 1044 entered it among the illustrated instruments, as a burning means for holding a wall or setting a tower alight. The Xia army carried oil as well, using it when storming and on night attacks to burn Song grain and scaling ladders. Apart from oil, the Song used fire chiefly in the form of fire arrows and fire balls: the arrows set the enemy line alight and harassed the baggage train, the fire balls screened dense formations during an assault. The Xia leaned instead on the armoured heavy horse and on cold weapons: man and beast both wore iron, the whole mount was made for the charge, and once the line was broken it did not linger but broke away at once. The Song lacked horses and had many foot to few horse, so it met the charge with the draw-heavy bow, the powerful Pili bow and the bed crossbow, ranged waggons as movable barricades, and grain and arrows carried with the marching baggage train, while the farms and the grain roads out of Guanzhong fed the far-flung forts.
tactics: 宋軍的戰術核心是堡寨梯次。沿邊先修城築寨，一寨控一段路，寨與寨之間以烽堠、驛馬與步騎巡邏相連；敵騎逼近時，先以城上弓弩與火矢覆蓋通道，逼其下馬攻坚，再以拒馬、鹿角和壕溝把騎兵牽制在牆下，等待援軍或反擊的時機。宋軍最吃虧的地方正在於援兵出堡太遠：一〇三八年好水川的宋軍離堡後在河谷中行軍，糧車落在後方，夏軍游騎先斷糧道，再以精騎埋伏於川谷兩側，兩翼以輕騎迂迴合圍，宋軍在疲餒中被衝散。宋廷事後總結出的辦法，是援軍不再遠出，而是固守城寨待敵，任敵人自己攻壁疲憊。西夏的戰術則是典型的分進合擊：一〇三八年九月起兵，先以步兵與工程器械攻定川寨一類邊寨，以騎兵分路直取鄜延，再以輕騎往來掠奪宋軍的糧草與驢馬，切斷隴右與關中之間的運輸；主力只在對方主力暴露或援軍離堡時才投入，以鐵鷂子一次衝鋒製造潰散，再用步兵填壕登城。攻城之後不遠追，就糧而止，因夏軍離開牧區遠行一日即食無所出。火在雙方戰術中都只是輔助手段：西夏用它燒糧草與攻城器械，宋軍用火矢與猛火油抵擋靠近城牆的人馬，真正的勝負仍由弓弩射程、壕寬牆高、糧道長短與騎兵衝鋒的動能決定。
tacticsEn: The core of the Song tactic was the ladder of forts. Along the frontier the line was walled and fortified first, one fort holding one stretch of road, and fort to fort joined by beacon towers, relay horses and patrols of foot and horse. When the enemy horse came up, the bows and crossbows on the walls and the fire arrows covered the road first, forcing the riders to dismount and attack on foot, while barricades, deer-horn abatis and ditches held the horse against the wall until the moment for a counter-stroke or for help. The Song suffered most exactly where the relieving column went too far out: in 1038 the Song troops at Haoshuichuan marched through the valley away from their fort, the grain waggons fell behind, the Xia light horse cut the supply road first and then the heavy horse lay in ambush on both sides of the ravine, the wings closed in, and the Song army was scattered while worn and hungry. The lesson the court drew afterwards was that the relieving column should no longer march out far but should sit in its forts and wait for the enemy to exhaust himself against the walls. The Xia tactic was the classic divided advance with a single stroke: the campaign opened in September 1038, infantry and engineers taking border forts such as Dingchuanzhai, horse columns striking straight for Fuyan by different roads, and light horse riding up and down to carry off the Song grain and mules, cutting the road between Longyou and Guanzhong. The main body was committed only when the enemy main force was exposed or a relieving column had left its fort, one charge of the iron vulture breaking the line, and infantry then filling the ditches and climbing the walls. After the city fell they did not pursue far but halted where there was food, because a Xia army one day away from its pastures had nothing to eat. Fire on both sides was only a subsidiary means: the Xia burned grain and siege gear, the Song answered approaching troops at the walls with fire arrows and fierce-fire oil, and the actual outcome was settled by the range of the bows, the width of the ditch and the height of the wall, by the length of the supply road, and by the momentum of the cavalry charge.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。時間：戰爭自一〇三八年六月元昊稱帝、兩國斷絕使節起，至慶曆四年（一〇四四）和議成，歷時約六年；一〇三八年九月定川寨失守，十月前後鄜延城破，十一月宋軍援兵敗於好水川，一〇四〇年二月又敗於鄜州三川口，一〇四一年二月曹瑋於好水川取勝，一〇四四年議和。兵力：宋人記載夏軍出動常以眾十萬概數書之，這是編年家的慣用概數，實際到陣的步騎當在數萬，作戰骨幹是鐵鷂子精騎；一〇三八年赴援好水川的宋軍，據記載為步騎萬餘，兵力對比在數倍以上。宋軍馬匹遠少於夏軍，能擔任反擊的精騎數量有限。損失：定川寨與鄜延失守時，宋軍死傷慘重、器械糧草盡失；好水川一役宋軍幾乎全軍覆沒，統兵官僅以身免；一〇四一年曹瑋之勝記斬首數千級、虜獲牛羊萬餘。疆域與物資：宋廷以沿邊堡寨數百座與沿線屯田維繫西北防線；慶曆和議的條件包括宋每年賜銀二萬兩、絹二萬匹，另按節慶致送禮物，並重開保安軍一帶榷場。凡涉及雙方確切死傷、各部損失比例、好水川與定川寨的具體日期與經過，諸史記載互有出入，只採可以互相印證的量級說法，不作精確斷言。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are roughly these. Timing: the war runs from June 1038, when Yuanhao proclaimed himself emperor and the two states stopped sending envoys, to the settlement of the fourth year of Qingli, 1044, a matter of about six years; Dingchuanzhai fell in September 1038, Fuyan was taken about a month later, the Song relieving force was beaten at Haoshuichuan in the eleventh month, the Song was beaten again at Sanchuankou in Fuzhou in the second month of 1040, Cao Wei won at Haoshuichuan in the second month of 1041, and the peace was made in 1044. Strength: Song writers habitually recorded a Xia army coming out as a hundred thousand men, which is the chroniclers' round number; the troops actually in the line were certainly some tens of thousands, with the armoured heavy horse as the fighting core; the Song force sent to relieve Haoshuichuan in 1038 is recorded as some ten thousand foot and horse, so the odds against it were several to one. The Song had far fewer horses than Xia, and only a limited body of horse could be used for counter-strokes. Losses: when Dingchuanzhai and Fuyan fell, the Song troops were badly cut up and lost all their equipment and grain; in the action at Haoshuichuan the Song army was very nearly wiped out and the commander escaped with his life alone; the Song victory of Cao Wei in 1041 is recorded as several thousand severed heads taken and more than ten thousand head of cattle and sheep captured. Territory and stores: the court held the north-west line with several hundred forts along the frontier and with farms on the roads feeding them; the terms of the Qingli settlement included a yearly grant from the Song of twenty thousand taels of silver and twenty thousand bolts of silk, further presents at the festivals, and the reopening of the trading posts around Baoan. For the exact casualties on either side, the losses of each arm, and the precise dates and course of the fighting at Haoshuichuan and Dingchuanzhai, the histories differ; only the order of magnitude that can be cross-checked is given here, and no exact assertion is made.
cause: 打起上來的根由是宋夏之間那道從未真正劃清的名分邊界。党項拓跋部自李繼遷受宋封定難軍節度使、據靈州以來，表面是宋的藩屬，實則自建官置、收部落、置屯田，朝廷歷來以加恩、賜地、通關市羈縻之。一〇三八年元昊遣使請稱帝號，宋廷議久不許，反而削其官封、停歲賜、閉榷場，等於逼他公開反叛；元昊隨即在興慶府建國，國號大夏，斷絕宋使，把自己從藩屬變成與宋平行的政權，戰端由此開。深層的理由有三：其一，夏國要在宋、遼之間取得獨立的地位，稱帝是唯一有效的手段；其二，黨項部眾按戶出丁、兵精而糧少，馬匹與牧場是立國之本，而關中是宋廷的倉廩，夏軍要的不是州郡而是能長期劫掠的通道與牧地，因此寧取堡寨、糧道而後取城池；其三，一〇三六年湟州吐蕃攻陷熙州，宋失去通往青唐的捷徑，陝西四路的防線被拉長，堡寨失修、將佐更迭頻繁，據編年記載一〇三八年環州一帶又曾有地震，邊寨城垣受損，守備的空虛給了夏軍可乘之機。
causeEn: The root of the fighting was the line of precedence between Song and Xia that had never really been drawn. Since Li Jiqian was invested by the Song as commissioner of Dingnan and based himself at Lingzhou, the Tangut Tuoba tribe had been a nominal vassal of the Song on the surface, while in fact ruling its own offices, gathering its own tribes and laying out its own farms; the court had always held them in check by favour, by grants of land and by opening and closing the border markets. In 1038 Yuanhao sent an envoy to ask for the title of emperor. The court deliberated at length, refused, and instead cut his titles, stopped the yearly payments and closed the markets, which amounted to forcing him into open rebellion; Yuanhao then founded his state at Xingqing under the name of Great Xia, broke off relations with the Song, and turned a vassal into a power standing level with the Song, and that was where the war began. Three deeper reasons lay behind it. First, Xia needed an independent standing between the Song and the Liao, and the imperial title was the only effective way to get it. Second, the Tangut households furnished soldiers, the army was sharp but badly fed, and horses and pastures were the foundation of the state; Guanzhong was the granary of the Song, and the Xia army did not want the prefectures but the roads and pastures it could plunder over a long time, which is why it took the forts and the supply roads first and the walled cities afterwards. Third, in 1036 the Tibetan forces of Huangzhou took Xizhou and the Song lost the short road to Qingtang, the line of the four Shaanxi circuits was stretched, the forts fell out of repair and the commanders were changed with some frequency, and the chronicles record an earthquake in the Huanzhou area in 1038 which damaged the walls of the border forts; the emptiness of the defence gave the Xia army its opening.
impact: 這場戰爭改變了北宋的西北政策。宋廷先後以陝西經略安撫使夏竦、經略安撫副使范仲淹等整頓邊防：換帥、修城築寨、募蕃兵與邊民為弓箭手、開屯田、備車隊，堡寨梯次防守的體制就是在這幾年裡成形的，日後成為宋對西夏的基本樣式，也一直用到熙寧、元豐諸役。范仲淹在條陳十事中提出的議和方案，經數年爭執，最後在慶曆和議中落實為封號、歲賜、榷場三件大事，北宋在西北由純粹的消耗轉為以互市與歲賜維繫的長期對峙，直到一〇六〇年代才再啟戰端。技術層面也留下痕跡：戰爭中大量使用火矢、火球與猛火油一類器械，《武經總要》在一〇四四年成書，把這一輪戰爭用過的器械、弓弩、攻城法與屯田法編成一體，等於把邊疆的實戰經驗制度化；沈括在延州幕府記下的石油，是中國早期把天然石油的燃燒性與用途連在一起記載的文字之一，這條記載此後沿著燃料與火藥的線索一路走下去。
impactEn: This war changed the northern-west policy of the Northern Song. The court set about reforming the frontier defence through men such as the commissioner Xia Song and the deputy commissioner Fan Zhongyan: changing commanders, repairing walls and building forts, recruiting Tibetan auxiliaries and border villagers as bowmen, opening farms and organising baggage trains. The ladder of forts, in which each fort held one stretch of the road and the next, took shape in these years; it became the standard Song answer to Xia and was used as late as the Xining and Yuanfeng campaigns. The terms Fan Zhongyan proposed in his Ten Articles, argued over for several years, were at last embodied in the three great clauses of the Qingli settlement — the title, the yearly payments and the trading posts — and the Song on the north-west front passed from pure attrition to a long stand-off maintained by trade and tribute, until the wars opened again in the 1060s. The technical side left its mark as well: fire arrows, fire balls and instruments of the fierce-fire oil kind were used in quantity, and the Wujing Zongyao, completed in 1044, gathered the instruments, bows, siege methods and farming methods of that round of war into a single system, which was in effect the institutionalising of frontier experience; and the note on petroleum made by Shen Kuo in the Yanzhou command is one of the earliest Chinese texts to join the burning quality of natural petroleum to its uses, a line that was later followed down the track of fuel and gunpowder.
result: 結果是兩敗俱傷、以和局收場。一〇三八至一〇三九年西夏連勝：定川寨與鄜延相繼失守，好水川宋援軍全軍覆沒，西夏一度進逼環慶與渭州，宋廷震動，陝西人心與朝議都為之搖動。一〇四〇年三川口再敗之後，宋廷被迫認真整軍，到一〇四一年曹瑋在好水川取勝、范仲淹的堡寨與屯田見效，攻守才拉成平手；雙方都打得筋疲力盡，一〇四一年西夏又與契丹交兵，腹背受敵，議和成了唯一的出路。慶曆四年，元昊上誓表稱臣，接受宋廷封為夏國主、每年賜銀絹、互市榷場重開的安排，宋夏邊界大致以環慶、鄜延沿線為限，戰爭至此結束。此後近二十年邊境無事，直到熙寧年間再起干戈。對卡面這件兵器可以確定的只有一句：希臘火與宋夏戰爭毫無關係，它的配方在七世紀末隨沉船失落，此後不曾再現；一〇三八年的陝西真正起作用的是弩、拒馬、壕溝與火矢，是堡寨與糧道，是把騎兵擋在牆下的體系。
resultEn: The outcome was mutual exhaustion and a settlement. From 1038 to 1039 Xia won in succession: Dingchuanzhai and Fuyan fell one after the other, the Song relieving army was wiped out at Haoshuichuan, the Xia troops pressed as far as the Huanqing and Weizhou lines, and the court was shaken, with the mood in Shaanxi and in the discussions at court disturbed. After the further defeat at Sanchuankou in 1040 the Song court was obliged to reform in earnest, and by 1041, with Cao Wei's victory at Haoshuichuan and Fan Zhongyan's forts and farms beginning to tell, the balance of attack and defence was restored to an even match. Both sides were exhausted, and in 1041 the Xia state went to war with the Khitan as well, pressed from two quarters, so negotiation was the only way out. In the fourth year of Qingli Yuanhao submitted a memorial of submission and accepted the Song investiture as Prince of Xia, the yearly payment of silver and silk, and the reopening of the trading posts; the Song-Xia border was fixed in rough outline along the Huanqing and Fuyan lines, and there the war ended. The frontier was quiet for nearly twenty years afterwards, until hostilities opened again in the Xining years. Of the weapon on this card only one thing can be said with certainty: Greek fire had nothing to do with the Song-Xia war; its formula was lost with a ship in the late seventh century and never appeared again, and what actually decided the fighting in Shaanxi in 1038 was the crossbow, the barricade, the ditch and the fire arrow, the fort and the supply road, the whole system that held the cavalry off at the wall.
